requirements.quote: With the pool token unresolvable, the daemon admits no remote lane, reports `preflight.pool_auth` once, and resumes admission when the token appears (no restart) [type:unit]
A pool agent version different from the CLI version reports `preflight.pool_version` with the upgrade command [type:unit]
A batch PATH whose wrapper resolves a shimmed tool back to the shim reports `preflight.path_loop` naming the dir [type:unit]
A sandbox clone failure ends `deferred` with code `sandbox.clone` and retry-in, and does not count toward the breaker [type:unit]
`forgedock doctor --lanes` prints every check with pass/fail [type:unit]
| The `gh` version lacks a `--json` field the engine uses | `preflight.gh_fields` | Field and gh version |
Add a preflight that runs at daemon start, at each batch admission pass, and on demand as `forgedock doctor --lanes`.

**When it fails:** admissions pause, which is not the breaker. It says once per batch why, and re-checks each pass, so the batch resumes by itself once the cause is fixed. None of these failures counts toward `orchestration.breaker`.

deliverables.change: New pure module with injected io: checkPoolAuth, checkPoolVersion, checkPathLoop, checkGhFields, runLaneChecks({exec,env,io}) -> [{code,ok,detail}], formatLaneChecks; pool checks only when execution provider is remote/pool/hybrid; ping 401 => pool_auth; version detail names agent, image version, CLI version and upgrade command
Unit tests for each check, pass and fail, incl. token appearing between two runs

Optional `preflight` seam checked each admission pass: failing => admit nothing, one batch row per distinct (code,detail), re-check next pass (self-resume), never noteEngineError; sandbox.clone deferral requeued with retryInSeconds and not counted by the breaker
Wire the preflight seam into runBatch using lanecheck.runLaneChecks
Run lane preflight at daemon start and log failures once
Type a sandbox clone/transport failure as terminalReason deferred, code sandbox.clone, retryInSeconds
`doctor --lanes` branch printing each check pass/fail, exit 1 on failure; usage text; wiring only
Export a pure shim-loop finder reused by lanecheck (next to guardChain), behaviour of guardChain unchanged

decisions.choice: New module named lanecheck.mjs, not preflight.mjs
decisions.justification: bin/lean/preflight.mjs:1-14 is the contract validate-command preflight (#4328); reusing the name would conflate them

decisions.choice: Preflight pauses admission via its own seam, not the breaker
decisions.justification: noteEngineError (bin/lean/orchestrate.mjs:541-549) only counts engine-error rows; the issue requires none of these count toward orchestration.breaker

decisions.choice: Agent version read from router GET /agents (capacity spreads versionOf)
decisions.justification: bin/pool/agent.mjs:94 spreads running version into capacity; bin/pool/router.mjs:267 exposes it
